evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: I set before you life and death, blessing and curse: choose life (weight 6.5). Pair score 6.5.

Only in Zedekiah's inquiry - the way of life and the way of death: The besieged king sends to ask the prophet to inquire of God, hoping God will do a wonder and make the enemy withdraw; God himself fights against his own people with outstretched hand and mighty arm, turning their weapons back; Whoever stays in the city will die, but whoever goes out and surrenders to the besiegers will live, his life as spoil; God redeems 'with an outstretched arm' and great judgments; The city is given into the hand of the king of Babylon who will burn it with fire; Judgment by the triad sword, famine and pestilence.

Only in The city: the two highways and the steep ascent: Giving food to the hungry (water, clothing, a ferry) as the deed that justifies before the judge; The companions of the right (ashab al-yamin, al-maymana) are saved; the companions of the left (al-mash'ama) are damned; A fire is closed over the damned (mu'sada); The steep ascent ('aqaba) is freeing a neck (slave), feeding an orphan relative or a needy man in the dust on a day of hunger; Ground cursed; man must eat by sweat of his brow among thorns and thistles [divergence between the texts]; Oath by 'this city' (Mecca), the secure city (al-balad al-amin); Whether a bound captive is released or killed; The fast God chooses is to loose bonds of injustice, free the oppressed, share bread with the hungry and clothe the naked; Ground cursed; man must eat by sweat of his brow among thorns and thistles; The evil is shut in below under a closed cover; Oath introduced by the negated formula 'No! I swear by...' (la uqsimu / fa-la uqsimu); Woe to every slanderer and backbiter (humaza lumaza) who amasses and counts wealth, thinking it makes him immortal; and 1 more.
